title: Onboard Computer and Trip Screen Issues
summary: Feedback about the G60's onboard computer is dominated by unclear references, with the clearest complaints pointing to computer-related malfunctions and communication issues.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the computer as a problem and mention a vehicle being sidelined by a computer-related issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention onboard computer communication, trip computer screens, glitches, and usability comments, but the excerpts are too incomplete or context-limited to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
Several excerpts are too short or lack surrounding context to tell whether they reflect praise, complaint, or a factual mention.
The cluster mixes malfunction reports with feature descriptions and unrelated uses of the word 'computer,' which limits thematic coherence.
